domain_entities.name: LeaveRequest
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee's application for leave. Tracks the full lifecycle from draft through submission, manager decision, and potential cancellation.
lifecycle_states: DRAFT — employee is composing the request; not yet visible to manager
SUBMITTED — employee has submitted; awaiting manager action
APPROVED — manager has approved; balance has been deducted
REJECTED — manager has rejected; no balance impact
CANCELLED — employee cancelled the request; can be reached from DRAFT, SUBMITTED, or APPROVED

domain_entities.name: LeaveRequestStatus
domain_entities.purpose: Enumeration of all possible states a LeaveRequest can occupy during its lifecycle.

domain_entities.name: LeaveType
domain_entities.purpose: Catalog of leave categories (annual, sick, emergency, unpaid, maternity, paternity). Each type governs which policy rules apply and how balances are tracked.
lifecycle_states: INACTIVE — retired; no new requests but historical data preserved

domain_entities.name: LeavePolicy
domain_entities.purpose: Defines the rules governing a specific leave type: how many days are entitled, accrual mechanics, notice requirements, and whether manager approval is needed.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — policy is in effect and governs new leave requests
INACTIVE — policy is retired; existing balances under this policy remain but no new requests accepted

domain_entities.name: LeaveBalance
domain_entities.purpose: Tracks an employee's entitlement, consumption, and remaining leave days for a specific leave type within a fiscal year. Deducted on approval; restored on cancellation of an approved request.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — balance is in effect for the current fiscal year
EXHAUSTED — remainingDays is zero; no further requests of this type can be approved
CLOSED — fiscal year ended; balance is archived and a new one created

business_rules: BR-DAY-COUNT: The number of leave days consumed by a request is calculated as (endDate - startDate + 1) — inclusive of both start and end dates. This formula applies everywhere: balance sufficiency checks, balance deduction on approval, balance restoration on cancellation, policy minimum/maximum enforcement, and reporting. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest, LeaveBalance, LeavePolicy appears, not only here]

BR-BALANCE-SUFFICIENCY: A LeaveRequest can only transition to SUBMITTED or APPROVED if the employee's LeaveBalance for that leaveTypeId and current fiscalYear has remainingDays >= the requested day count (computed per BR-DAY-COUNT). This check fires at submission time and again at approval time (balance may have changed between submission and approval). [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest, LeaveBalance appears, not only here]
